title: Factory task queue (.factory/tasks.json)
description: Written only by the orchestrator. Agents read the task they are assigned; they never write this file. See TASK-CONTRACT.md.

project.description: Matches project.yaml `name`; the slug every factory-root path component is built from (F-62).

attempt_reset.description: One owner-directed budget reset. prior_attempts is the task's attempts-array length at reset time; the budget for slice_id counts only attempts at positions >= it (attempts are append-only, so the position is stable).

evidence.description: What the owner checked before granting more attempts

slice_id.description: The slice whose budget was reset (the escalated attempt's slice; the task id when unsliced)

ref.description: test node id, command, holdout scenario id, or live_checks key

model.description: Model per seat, e.g. implementer=glm-5.3 verifier=glm-5.3

provider.description: F-59: the attempt's provider record — kind, model (when the profile names one; absent for a self project with no provider block, whose seats run the CLI default), region or endpoint host, from the PARENT's resolver (never the session's claim, never a credential). Absent on every attempt recorded before F-59.

provider_usage.description: F-59/R1-5: the per-(kind, model) usage breakdown over this attempt's records, each attributed to its own parent-stamped provider (records without one attribute to the attempt's primary provider). Telemetry only; drives no decision.

token_usage.description: F-59: session-REPORTED token usage (input, cache read, cache write, output), summed per attempt and validated — non-negative ints only; a forged or unparsable count is null (unknown), never 0. Telemetry like turns since F-64: it drives no decision.

sandbox_bypass_denials.description: F-42: Bash calls this attempt's sessions made with dangerouslyDisableSandbox, denied by the PreToolUse hook — summed off the session records; factory status totals them for the week.

validator_report.description: Path to the stored validator report

prompt_versions.description: seat -> prompt content hash (F-09); used for credit assignment in F-19

skills.description: Skills loaded in the session, name@version

final_review.description: F-41: the final full review after fix rounds, when one ran in this attempt — its verdict, its findings, and whether it was a repeat after a failed one. Absent when no final review ran (a first-round pass skips it: that review was already full).

repeat.description: True when this final review repeated a failed one (AC-3's bounded repeat).

reported_by.description: 1-based reviewer numbers that reported the finding.

review_drops.description: F-38: findings the L2 verifier voted out or the nit budget capped, each with its drop reason — the reviewer noise the verifier removed, in the attempt record so F-19 can measure it. Deliberately NOT rendered into the PR body (the stored validator report carries the same ledger for audit).

reason.description: The verifier's drop reason (e.g. 'style-only: …', 'not real: …') or 'nit_budget'.

reported_by.description: 1-based reviewer numbers that reported the finding.

sentinels.description: Sentinel results recorded for this attempt (F-25): every sentinel L0 ran, pass or fail, so the human merge sees what was checked.

source.description: Repo-relative path + optional #heading of the doc that owns the spec

items.description: Task id, or repo:id for cross-repo

scope.description: F-65: the files this contract may change — repo-relative globs on the scope matcher (gates.scope_matches: * and ? never cross /, ** spans directories, case-sensitive on the exact git path). Inside contract_hash, so widening needs re-approval. Optional so pre-F-65 entries load, but every ELIGIBLE_KINDS task (build, docs) must declare it: approval refuses without it and the run escalates scope_missing. Malformed patterns (absolute, .., empty, catch-all, character classes) refuse at load (contract._check_task_scope).

out_of_scope.description: Things this task must not change or add. Written at approval; gives the L2 spec axis something concrete to check scope creep against. Not part of acceptance_hash.

dependencies.description: F-71 AC-4: the dependencies this contract adds. Inside contract_hash (a widened list is a new contract). Names normalised per ecosystem (PEP 503 for pypi, lowercase for npm); a direct manifest addition not declared here escalates new_dependency. Declaring any refuses --yes at approval (a human looks).

acceptance_hash.description: sha256 of canonical acceptance JSON, set at spec approval

evidence.description: What the owner checked; required with done: true (F-29)

size.description: L is not allowed: slice it

max_turns.description: Maximum (F-64 AC-3, owner-confirmed 2026-11-10): the highest value in today's queues (200, this repo). Work that needs more is too big: slice it.

wall_clock_min.description: Maximum (F-64 AC-3, owner-confirmed 2026-11-10): the highest value in today's queues (150, this repo). Work that needs more is too big: slice it.

attempt_resets.description: Owner-directed attempt-budget resets (factory recover --reset-attempts), append-only like attempts. The budget counts only attempts after the latest reset marker; history is never deleted.

escalation_pr.description: F-72: links.pr is an ESCALATION draft PR — the run's work kept for the owner's judgement, never validated as a PR. While set, the sweep never re-validates it or reports it ready, it never counts against repo.concurrency, and only `factory recover --accept` (new_dependency/risk_path_touched) or the owner's own hand-merge advances the task; accept clears the marker (the PR is then a normal in_review PR).

merged.description: F-26: the URL of the PR GitHub reported merged. Terminal for that PR only — while links.pr equals it, the link is never gh-polled, counted open, or re-validated again and the task waits in in_review for the F-14 deploy gate (a no-deploy profile — deploy.mechanism none-form with empty live_checks — closes it to done/awaiting_owner instead, the merge the evidence); a later PR on the task (links.pr changes) is not covered.

revalidated.description: F-26 stale-base cache: the (pr branch sha, default head sha) pair this PR was last re-validated against. An unchanged pair is not re-run; written by the sweep on every pass.

allOf.$comment: F-29: an owner_only task has no contract to freeze; it is done when it has owner steps and every one is ticked.
